summary: Harden inactive jobs decoding, normalize claim bodies and fence read-only queries after repairs.

replay.detail: Malformed schema-admitted job records become refused raw history instead of poisoning projection, open or rebuild. Direct record bodies and fields envelopes use the same fold.

schema.detail: Subject-scoped replica-record repair insertion/update/deletion triggers enqueue only affected jobs. No generic fold, runtime repair dispatch or smallclaims implementation changes.

rules.detail: Inactive history only; no execution authority or host activation.

compatibility.detail: Public jobs/history/receipt reads require a Transaction snapshot and return typed JobsProjectionStale for pending subjects; queues also fence candidate hosts. Reads remain read-only and never drain pending work or acquire the writer. History exposes raw record JSON so malformed records remain inspectable.

manual.detail: No operator action. Pending repairs clear through existing flush/open/rebuild hooks; automatic repair-page dispatch is deferred to separately approved unit 4c-2. Until then typed stale results intentionally fence affected reads.

recovery.detail: Repair fixtures require stale reads before flush, no read-path writes, and equivalence of explicit flush with rebuild. No full-replay fallback is introduced.
